resources.string: Settings and listening history from the official app

In the official BitChord app, open Settings, then Your data, then Export data, and save the JSON file. Choose that file here.\n\nSettings, Automix, crossfade, lyrics sources, and listening history are restored. Sign-in, addon configuration, passwords, and the download checklist are not in that file, so they stay in the official app. Tracks already saved to Music/BitChord still show under Local music. If you had picked a local-music folder, pick it again so this app can read it.
Restored %1$d settings and %2$d months of listening from BitChord %3$s. Sign in again for your library.
How much DJ Automix plays between songs
Every level beat-matches on the phrase and keeps one bassline at a time. Higher levels add stem tricks and effects, and fall back to a clean fade when a pair doesn\'t suit them.
